# Analysis: Add write operations to Jira gateway (create/update/comment/link)

> Issue: #1924 | Phase: refine

(Full analysis preserved on branch egg/issue-1924 at .egg-state/drafts/1924-analysis.md and .egg-state/brc-history/1924-refine.md. Source of truth: issue body's "Decided Design" section, which carries forward all decisions A1 + B1 + C1 + D1 + E1 plus per-question resolutions D1-D28 and Q12-Q26. Re-runs must treat these as settled and not re-surface them.)

The recommended approach is **A1 + B1 + C1 + D1 + E1**:
- A1: four dedicated narrow routes (`/api/v1/jira/ticket/create`, `/ticket/edit`, `/ticket/comment/add`, `/issue-link/create`); /execute stays GET-only.
- B1: split the method allowlist - validate_jira_api_path keeps ALLOWED_METHODS={GET}; new write client methods bypass it.
- C1: curated body schema with field allowlist; reject custom-field passthrough.
- D1: caller-supplied idempotency key + in-process cache (5-min TTL) for create / comment / link.
- E1: agent-friendly sandbox wrapper with --description / --description-file / --description-stdin etc.

Permanent denylist preserved (transitions / worklog / attachments / watchers / DELETE on /execute). All Q15 body caps locked in (summary <=255, description/comment <=32 KiB, labels <=30 x 50). customFields disabled. notifyUsers default false. Cross-project parent rejected. Strict allowlist on createIssueLink (both inward and outward). Idempotency cache covers link verb too (D28). 429 audit emitted on every write (Q12).

pr:
  title: "Add bounded Jira write verbs to the gateway (create/edit/comment/link)"
  description: |
    Issue #1556 shipped the v1 read-only Jira gateway. Issue #1557 (Jira-epic SDLC pipelines) is now blocked on the write counterpart. This PR is the bounded write extension that unblocks #1557.

    Four new gateway routes under /api/v1/jira/* (ticket/create, ticket/edit, ticket/comment/add, issue-link/create), four new JiraClient write methods that bypass validate_jira_api_path, per-verb body schema with size caps and custom-field rejection, ADF wrapping helper, in-memory idempotency cache (5-min TTL, covers create/comment/link), four new sandbox wrapper subcommands, full test grid extension, and docs/reference/jira-wrapper.md "Write verbs" section.

    The v1 read-only invariants are preserved verbatim: *.atlassian.net stays out of the Squid allowlist, Atlassian credentials remain gateway-only, the permanent denylist (transitions, worklog, attachments, watchers, DELETE) is unchanged, and /execute stays GET-only.

    Post-merge: none. Routes inert until #1557 ships.
